toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Headset stand (synthetic demo costs) under demo-direct rule as of 2026-10-24. At a 5% revenue margin target, the undiscounted recommended price is BRL 31.38 and the discounted charged price at 10% off is BRL 28.24. The undiscounted scenario keeps contribution positive at BRL 1.5753, while the discounted scenario turns contribution negative at BRL -1.2507. The discount does not retain the requested revenue margin.
assumptions: Synthetic demonstration data was used for both product costs and channel rule; data is confirmed only as demonstration, not business-verified.
All revenue charges in the rule share the same revenue basis as provided: 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, plus BRL 2 fixed fee.
Margin target refers to revenue margin, not markup on production cost.
Discount is applied to the recommended price after the margin-based price is computed.
limitations: Failure provision assumes the provided full-print retry model only.
No marketplace verification is available; rule is synthetic and not Shopee.
Contribution is not net profit; a negative discounted contribution does not imply full business loss accounting for omitted overhead or other effects.
